summary: Frontend-only testing (mobile 430x900) of the new 6-language translation system in MikiLab. VERIFIED WORKING: (1) header language switcher ([data-testid=lang-switcher] -> native [data-testid=lang-select]) changes the whole UI and persists to localStorage mikilab_lang; document.documentElement.dir flips to rtl for FA; (2) FA recipe detail is fully Persian for 2 recipes (basi 'Miglioratore Naturale Pro' and pane 'Baguette con Poolish'): title, real-name subtitle, flour_type, all ingredient names (base + extras) and the whole procedure - zero Italian words in the procedure of the basi recipe (regex scan returned an empty Latin-word set); (3) RTL layout is correct - labels right-aligned, gram/percent values render LTR and un-garbled (1000 g / 100%, 0.3%, 18 g / 1.8%), header + bottom nav usable and clickable in FA; (4) EN ingredient translation verified (Pure diastatic malt powder, Sweet lupin flour, Acerola powder, Golden flaxseed flour, Psyllium husk, Butter 82% for lamination, Fresh yeast, Acacia honey); (5) FR verified (Beurre 82% pour le beurrage, Jaunes d'oeufs, Sucre semoule, Miel d'acacia + French title/procedure); (6) same recipe (Cornetti all'Italiana, 11 extra ingredients) switched through all 6 languages via recipe-lang-* chips - IT/DE/EN/ES/FR/FA all render titles, real-name, ingredients and procedure fully localised (only intentional proper nouns remain: 'Lievito Madre', 'Poolish', 'Biga', 'Kochstueck', 'tour'); (7) API cross-check: all 549 extra_ingredients across 121 recipes have name_de/en/es/fr/fa populated (0 missing); (8) regression: 5 cat-folder-* folders load with correct counts (6/32/59/12/12), the 'Ricette Custodite' collection loads and localises in FA (custodite-open-matera detail fully Persian), 6 consecutive language switches produced no pageerror and no blank screen; (9) Lab smoke: nav-tab-maestro opens, capo-module-turni/macchine/forni/notte all present and toggle (aria-pressed false->true), goal selector present as [data-testid=capo-plan-goal] (NOT 'plan-goal' as stated in the request).

ui_bugs.issue: Static Lab copy is NOT translated for fa (and partially es/fr): with FA active the Lab shows English labels mixed with Persian - 'START - base steps & switches', 'Advanced AI Settings', 'Calculation filters: turn on only what the AI should consider...', 'Work shifts', 'Optimise ovens', 'Night pauses', 'Shopping list', 'Baking schedule', 'Start times', 'Cells & Mixers', 'Hydration Calc'. Root cause: these strings come from inline {it,de,en,es,fr} literal maps / the 3-arg tri() helper, which has no fa entry and falls back to English.

Marketing badges and the quote stay English in FA: '100% Natural', 'Healthier', 'Highly digestible', 'No chemical additives', 'A healthier, more digestible bread that respects your gut...'. Source RicetteCustodite.jsx has it/de/en/es/fr but no fa key (146 'es:' entries, 0 'fa:').

Recipe-detail static labels built with the 3-language tri() helper fall back to English for es/fr/fa: 'Phase 1 - Vorteig (Biga)', 'Phase 2 - Main dough', 'Fresh yeast' (RecipeList.jsx lines 779/783/791), 'Machine sheet'. Visible e.g. on Brioche Francese in ES where ingredients are Spanish but the yeast row reads 'Fresh yeast' and phase titles are English.

issues: The horizontal category chip row (custodite-filters) is clipped on the LEFT edge in RTL - the last chip is cut off screen; RTL horizontal scroll start position needs fixing
Labels mix languages: 'Home' and 'Social' stay English while the rest is Italian (pre-existing)
5x 401 console errors from /api/auth/me and /api/notifications on every guest load (pre-existing, reported in iteration_109)

action_items: Add `fa` (and verify es/fr) entries to the inline language maps in sections/RicetteCustodite.jsx (146 maps), sections/PianoProduzioneAI.jsx (53), components/RecipeGenerator.jsx, sections/CalcolatoreSequenze.jsx, components/ProfilePanel.jsx, AvatarBubbles.jsx etc. - all of them currently have 0 `fa:` keys, so FA falls back to English there.
Extend the 3-arg tri() usages in RecipeList.jsx (biga phase titles, 'Fresh yeast', 'Machine sheet') to 6 languages, otherwise ES/FR/FA recipe details keep English phase labels.
Fix RTL horizontal scroll start for custodite-filters chip row (chip clipped at left edge in FA).
Note for the request author: the Lab goal selector testid is `capo-plan-goal`, not `plan-goal`.
critical_code_review_comments: Localisation is split between i18n/fa.js (keyed t() strings, complete) and dozens of inline {it,de,en,es,fr} object literals inside section components - the inline pattern is the single source of every missing-FA string found. Consider migrating these to the keyed t() system or adding a lint check that every inline map containing `es:` also contains `fa:`.

RecipeList.jsx and RicetteCustodite.jsx are very large (>1200 / >700 lines) and duplicate ingredient-row rendering logic (extras rendered with e[`name_${lang}`] || ingLoc in RecipeList ~601 and ~1150 plus lib/shopping.js) - extract a shared ingredient-name resolver.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); GET /api/recipes verified via curl - 121 recipes, all extras have 5 translations
success_rate.frontend: 8/8 requested checks executed; 6 fully pass, 2 pass with the static-UI-copy FA/ES/FR gaps listed above

test_credentials: Not needed - recipes are public. admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! available if required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: localStorage mikilab_newsletter_popup_seen='1', mikilab_lab_tour_done='1' (the lab tour still appeared once in IT, so the tour key may differ), mikilab_lang='<code>' then reload. Language can also be changed with the native SELECT [data-testid=lang-select] (select_option) or per-recipe chips [data-testid=recipe-lang-it|de|en|es|fr|fa] on the detail page (these change the global language + localStorage). Recipes: nav-tab-ricette -> cat-folder-basi/viennoiserie/pane/focacce/snack -> recipe-row-<id>; procedure at recipe-procedure-<id>. Protected recipes: tap the 'Ricette Custodite' hub card -> custodite-open-<key>. Lab goal selector = capo-plan-goal. NOT tested this run: shopping list extras localisation (lib/shopping.js), personal-recipes ('mie ricette') separation (no logged-in personal recipes), print/PDF and TTS in FA.
rca_of_the_issue: All recipe DATA translations (titles, real_name, flour_type, notes, procedure, 549 extra_ingredient names) are complete and render correctly in all 6 languages including RTL Persian. The only remaining 'Italian/English leftovers' come from static UI copy defined as inline {it,de,en,es,fr} literals or via the 3-arg tri(it,de,en) helper, neither of which has a Persian branch; therefore FA (and ES/FR for tri()) silently render the English string.
